segments.he: וְנִכְפֶּה — כְּמוּמִין שֶׁבַּסֵּתֶר דָּמֵי. וְהָנֵי מִילֵּי דִּקְבִיעַ לֵיהּ זְמַן, אֲבָל לָא קְבִיעַ לֵיהּ — כְּמוּמִין שֶׁבַּגָּלוּי דָּמֵי.
segments.en: «And an epileptic is considered like a hidden blemish,» for it is possible that nobody is aware of her ailment. The Gemara comments: «And this applies» only «if» the sickness comes «at regular intervals,» as the woman and her family can conceal her illness. «But» if the attacks do «not» appear «at regular» intervals and can occur at any time, this «is considered like a visible blemish,» as it is impossible that her condition is unknown to others.
